training_data_type: REAL measured turbine SCADA telemetry (not synthetic) — Kelmarsh Wind Farm (UK), ALL 6 real Senvion MM92 turbines, 10-minute resolution, 4 full years (2016-2019)
known_limitation: Wind speed sensor is at actual nacelle/hub height (~90m) already, not a 50m reference reading like NASA POWER's WS50M — the same wind-shear transform is applied at both training and inference for consistency, a documented simplification. Elevation was held constant (single real site, Kelmarsh ~140m) — the model has not learned genuine elevation sensitivity. All 6 real turbines and all 4 available years (2016-2019) were used — this is now the full available real dataset, not a subset.
